review.notes: The pre-errata cdb text matches lineage v5 (LCYW-EN019, 2012-09-29) exactly, so the recorded chain starts there; the earlier transitions v0 (MRD-075, 2002) through v4 (DPYG-EN006, 2009) are wording modernisations of the same Tribute-for-half-ATK effect and predate the baseline implementation, so they are not recorded as changes. One further script difference is NOT text-driven and is not recorded as its own change: the modern script gates the Release cost on s.cfilter (c:GetAttack()>0) while the pre-errata script passes nil, so the historical implementation permits Tributing a 0-ATK monster for 0 damage. No source in the packet dates that refinement; it is carried by the baseline implementation, which every pre-2014-06-27 snapshot selects anyway, so it does not need its own (blocking) unresolved-chronology entry. The second upstream code 511004015 is 'Catapult Turtle (Anime)' - a different card with three anime-only effects - and is excluded rather than folded in as an artwork variant.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the once-per-turn text (DL18-EN001, Duelist League 18 participation cards)

event.historical_text: You can Tribute 1 monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the Tributed monster's ATK on the field.
event.modern_text: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the Tributed monster's ATK on the field.
event.summary: Functional erratum: the Tribute-for-damage Ignition effect became a hard once per turn. The modern script carries e1:SetCountLimit(1) and pre-errata/c511000228.lua does not, so the historical card can Tribute monsters for damage repeatedly in one turn. EdisonFormat.com records the same period behaviour independently.
